overview.description: The Baron First Principles ETF (RONB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through investments in US companies of any market capitalization. Stock selection uses fundamental research and a philosophy of questioning everything. RONB was launched on Dec 15, 2025 and is issued by Baron.
